children: advanced to $240.97, up approximately 3.54% at 10.50am EST October 22. The earnings report gave investors plenty to work with: quarterly revenue cleared 10 billion for the first time, while cloud demand kept expanding. The bigger test is whether that momentum can keep lifting profits.

SAP's quarterly statement showed cloud revenue climbing 26% to 6.67 billion, non-IFRS operating profit rising 18% to 3.03 billion and free cash flow jumping 36% to 1.72 billion. According to Reuters' reporting, current cloud backlog grew 26% at constant currencies to 24.14 billion, beating UBS's forecast for 24%25% growth. SAP now expects cloud revenue toward the upper end of its annual guidance, while keeping its operating-profit outlook unchanged.

The valuation graphic puts the $240.97 share price 6.07% below the $256.55 GF Value estimatea modest discount that leaves execution firmly in focus. A larger contracted revenue base improves visibility, but contracts still need to become recognized revenue and cash. Fourth-quarter delivery will determine whether SAP can turn strong cloud demand into a stronger finish to the year.

title: SAP Stocks Rise 3.54% as Cloud Backlog Extends Momentum
